title: Are All Game Glitches Just Accidents?

scenes.text: The common belief is that every glitch is an unintended mistake.
scenes.label: All glitches accidental

scenes.text: Some glitches, like Pokémon’s MissingNo. and Skyrim’s “Fus Ro Da” speedrun exploit, were left in on purpose as easter eggs or to aid speedrunners.
scenes.label: Some glitches intentional

scenes.text: Not all bugs are bugs—some are secret features.
scenes.label: Secret features

scenes.text: Follow for daily tech and AI news.

description: Glitches aren’t always mistakes; developers sometimes hide them as easter eggs or speedrun tools. Uncover the truth behind famous “bugs”. Follow for more hidden gaming facts!
